text:
Jules: Hi team, booked a metro card in Madrid. Corpcard charged in EUR but merchant later posted a separate "reconversion" fee line when they settled in GBP. I paid the reconversion fee personally to complete the transaction. Attached screenshots and the two receipts. Do I submit for reimbursement?

Tom (Finance): Submit as personal reimbursement with both PDFs. We'll review whether fee was a merchant DCC or bank reconversion. If merchant added it after settlement, Finance normally reimburses only if it was unavoidable.

Jules: It looks like the POS offered to convert to GBP at checkout, I declined but they added a post-sale reconversion. I have timestamps showing corpcard initial auth in EUR then the reconversion line later.

Marcus (Accounting): For GL mapping: base fare -> Travel - Transport; merchant reconversion -> Bank/FX fees. If we reimburse, it will be posted as Bank Fees and not travel cost. Also note if corpcard bore the main charge we may not reimburse the reconversion unless policy exception.

Helena (Travel Ops): Can you share vendor name? If it's a recurring issue we should either remove them from preferred list or flag to travel vendor manager.

Jules: Vendor = MetroFast SL. Attached receipts: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/2009901111-metro1.pdf and https://files.redwood.example/receipts/2009901111-reconv.pdf. Submitted expense EXP-4999 with note "merchant added reconversion post-sale" and tagged @Tom @Marcus.

ExpenseBot: EXP-4999 received. Status: pending review. Estimated processing 3 business days.

Tom (Finance): Reviewing now. Marcus, if we approve reimbursing reconversion, we should route to bank-fees GL and not charge project budgets. Marcus: agreed?

Marcus (Accounting): Agreed. Also if vendor repeatedly posts DCC we'll request invoice adjustments but usually they don't reverse.

Tom (Finance): Approved reimbursement as exception given you couldnt avoid it and it was under 25 GBP. We'll reimburse via bank transfer. Travel Ops please flag vendor.

Helena (Travel Ops): Noted. Ill add MetroFast SL to vendor watchlist and reach out.

Jules: Thanks everyone, appreciate the quick turnaround. Closing thread.
